Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: Persistent Seiton decisions, PvP warnings, and an optional physical-input Purify helper.
Description: A local Crystalline Conflict reaction-cue HUD with an optional Wolves' Den duel test mode. Ninja gets persistent PREP and SHIFT+slot Seiton decisions; every job can see selected PvP warnings. The one-attempt Purify helper supports fresh keys plus a separate held-key option and individual toggles for every removable CC type.
Changelog: Added a separate default-off held-key trigger, including WASD and hotbar keys. Physical key generations are consumed when Purify arms, so ReAction Turbo pulses and one continuous hold cannot create another Seiton Sense attempt until release. Fresh-key behavior and all six per-debuff toggles remain unchanged.
